parameters.name: DeviceName
parameters.description:
The name of the device that owns the tag.
> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **ProductKey**.

parameters.name: IotId
parameters.description:
The ID of the device that owns the tag.
> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** or **DeviceName**. The **IotId** parameter is a globally unique identifier (GUID) of the device, which corresponds to a combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. If you specify both **IotId** and the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. On the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the **ID** of the current instance.

><notice>
- If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no <props="intl"><ph>**Overview** page or </ph></props>ID is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description:
The ProductKey of the product to which the device that owns the tag belongs.
> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.

parameters.name: PropKey
parameters.description:
The key of the device tag to delete.

> IoT Platform searches for the key that you specify among the tags of the target device and deletes the corresponding tag. If no tag key matches the key that you specify, no operation is performed.
